name: Switch

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether or not the Switch should be disabled

props.name: index
props.description: The index of your Switch in your ContentSwitcher that is used for event handlers. Reserved for usage in ContentSwitcher

props.name: name
props.description: Provide the name of your Switch that is used for event handlers

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether your Switch is selected. Reserved for usage in ContentSwitcher

props.name: text
props.description: Provide the contents of your Switch

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Switch rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
